10.1038/s41592-018-0049-4.contribution: Flood-filling networks add recurrent object context to a convolutional network, allowing it to extend a neuronal segmentation iteratively.
10.1038/s41592-018-0049-4.result: The authors report a mean error-free neurite path length of 1.1 mm and four merge errors across a 97 mm test path, with an order-of-magnitude improvement over earlier approaches tested on the same dataset.
10.1038/s41592-018-0049-4.context: Neurons in a zebra finch brain dataset acquired with serial block-face electron microscopy.
10.1038/s41592-018-0049-4.limitation: The reported accuracy improvement required substantially greater computation. These are results on the stated test data, not evidence of equivalent performance on every connectomics dataset.
